propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations with duplicated basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env handling decisions, three of which lack --basetemp entirely.
A consolidated run_nested_pytest helper must be created that always appends --basetemp, forwards env verbatim without merging onto os.environ, and propagates subprocess.TimeoutExpired unmodified.
The helper must pass a plain dict env mapping to subprocess.run without any SubprocessEnv method calls, and return CompletedProcess by identity to satisfy security and contract constraints.
All fourteen nested launch sites across tests/ must be converted to use the helper, with fourteen-site AST uniqueness guard and one-definition grep guard to prevent future re-introduction.

The three sites lacking --basetemp (bare_repository_fixture_portability, git_version_floor, live_jira_xdist_confinement) must gain it; two console-script modules (test_scripts_import_convention.py, test_tests_import_convention.py) must remain unconverted to preserve their bug reproductions.
